title: Tidewatch Cottage | KEY.co
description_expanded: This stunning home offers the perfect blend of luxury and convenience, located just moments from the newly opened WaterColor Beach Club and the popular lazy river at Camp WaterColor. With easy access to the Marina Pool, Tennis, Boathouse, and a variety of nearby shops and restaurants, guests will have no shortage of activities to enjoy. The home's beautifully upgraded kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances, is ideal for preparing everything from quick beach snacks to delicious home-cooked meals. The open-concept living area and screened porch provide ample space for everyone to unwind after a fun-filled day. With spacious accommodations across two levels, this home is designed for comfort and relaxation. The main-floor master suite boasts a king bed and ensuite bathroom, while the second floor features two guest rooms—one with two queen beds and another with a king—along with an alcove that sleeps two additional guests. For even more privacy, the charming cottage house above the garage offers two queen beds, a sofa bed, and plenty of space to relax. Whether enjoying time together or seeking a quiet retreat, this home is the perfect setting for a memorable beach getaway.
